special_components.name: TracingBeamCard
special_components.description: A card with a glowing gradient border that follows the perimeter, used for the 'Best Bet' or 'Analyst Pick'.

special_components.name: TerminalOutput
special_components.description: A text block that simulates typing for the Analyst Report, using a monospaced font and a blinking cursor.

special_components.name: ProbabilityGauge
special_components.description: Custom SVG donut chart or linear progress bar with distinct color zones (Red/Yellow/Green) for Poisson results.

visual_enhancers.shadows: None by default, 'glow' effects for active states
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.02) on background to reduce banding
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (default), sized 16px or 20px for density

motion.loading: Simulated terminal scrolling text or progress bar with 'calculating...' steps

background_hero.desc: Abstract wavy metallic surface, use with heavy overlay (opacity 0.1) as app background

analysis_texture.desc: Neon blue line chart on grid, use for 'Analysis Mode' headers or loading states

football_mood.desc: Minimalist soccer ball on black sand, use for Empty States or 'No Match Selected'

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL: yarn add @radix-ui/react-icons lucide-react recharts framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge
SETUP: Configure tailwind.config.js to add the specific neon colors and fonts (JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Sans).
COMPONENT: Build a 'MatchInputForm' that looks like a command palette or a trading ticket.
COMPONENT: Build a 'ProbabilityMatrix' grid for exact scores (Poisson distribution visualization).
CRITICAL: Ensure the Analyst Report text is rendered with a 'typewriter' effect using framer-motion.
CRITICAL: Dark Mode only. Force 'dark' class on the root HTML element.
CRITICAL: Use Italian language for all static text (Squadra Casa, Squadra Trasferta, Probabilità, Quote).
DATA: Ensure all probabilities are formatted to 1-2 decimal places (e.g., 45.2%).
TESTING: Add data-testid to the 'Analyze' button and the 'Result Card'.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for main backgrounds, only for subtle borders or active states.
Use glass-morphism sparingly (only for sticky headers/overlays), prefer solid high-contrast backgrounds for data readability.
Interactive elements must have immediate feedback (hover color change, scale 0.98 on click).
Avoid 'AI slop' rounded corners. Go for sharp (rounded-sm) or semi-sharp (rounded-md) to match the professional trading vibe.
Use 'sonner' for notifications (e.g., 'Analysis Complete', 'Error Fetching Data').
